// Package server serves things.
package server

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

/* Config holds
   the configuration. */
type Config struct {
	Addr    string        `json:"addr"`
	Timeout time.Duration `json:"timeout,omitempty"`
}

type Handler interface {
	ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
}

func New(cfg Config) (*Server, error) {
	if cfg.Addr == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("server: empty address %q", cfg.Addr)
	}
	return &Server{cfg: cfg, routes: map[string]Handler{}}, nil
}

func (s *Server) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	srv := &http.Server{Addr: s.cfg.Addr, ReadTimeout: 5 * time.Second}
	go func() {
		<-ctx.Done()
		_ = srv.Shutdown(context.Background())
	}()
	defer fmt.Println("stopped")
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		default:
		}
	}
	raw := `a raw
string`
	var n int64 = 0x1F + 0o17 + 1e3
	_ = raw
	_ = n
	return srv.ListenAndServe()
}

func encode(v any) ([]byte, error) {
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return b, nil
}
